negative_reviews.author: Rosana Anunciacao
negative_reviews.text:
I genuinely don't understand how this restaurant has such a high rating.

We walked past it a few days earlier and decided to give it a try because it had great reviews and looked like a really nice place. Unfortunately, it turned out to be a huge disappointment.

The service was embarrassingly poor and completely below the standard the restaurant claims to offer. The place itself looked dirty and gave the impression of very poor hygiene.

The most shocking part was the sushi. It was absolutely awful—worse than cheap supermarket sushi. It certainly didn't taste fresh and definitely didn't seem like it had been made that day. The only decent thing we had was the fried chicken, which was actually quite good. Sadly, that wasn't enough to make up for the rest of the experience.

After leaving my review, I did a quick Google search and discovered that the restaurant only opened on 10 April 2026. What I found even more surprising was that it already had over 400 reviews, the vast majority of them positive. Given the quality of our experience, I genuinely struggle to understand how that is possible. While I can't say why this is the case, the numbers simply don't seem to add up from my perspective.

Overall, it was a complete disappointment from beginning to end, and I certainly wouldn't recommend it.

negative_reviews.author: David Mikaelson
negative_reviews.text:
Food was ok but seaweed in the hand roll is chewy. Good quality fish like many other high end places in London but service could be improved a lot.

The waitress got our order wrong, service was very slow and it was difficult to get the attention from the waitresses. All the items I ordered came first while my partner had to wait more than 20 mins later to get any handrolls. We went for early dinner and the place was not even half full. The toilet is not clean and they use fake aesop (refill with a different hand wash).

Overall quite a disappointing experience and would not come back. For this price point, you’re better off going to Nobu, Chotto Matte, Sushi Samba, Sushinoen, Kokin, etc.
